about: The firmware the suite's apps work with, and where Nexus Deps learns of its updates (nexus_deps/upstreams.py). No emulator is listed: each emulator app chooses its version from GitHub's list itself. Hand-written: id, name, what, kind, url, targets, how, and per app its app. Synced from the portal's apps.toml by `dev/deps/run.sh --sync-upstreams` (tests/test_upstreams.py fails while it is stale): name and launcher.

sony.name: DualSense firmware
sony.what: the firmware of the DualSense and DualSense Edge controllers
sony.how: Connect the controller with a USB cable and open {apps}: it reads the controller's firmware, compares it with Sony's and updates it (the Edge's profiles are backed up first). Bluetooth is not enough for an update.

sony.name: PS4 system software
sony.what: the PlayStation 4's system software, from Sony's update list
sony.how: Update on the console: Settings, System Software Update. Remote Play with {apps} may need the console's newest system software.

sony.name: PS5 system software
sony.how: Sony publishes no update list a program can read safely. The console says when an update is out: Settings, System, System Software, System Software Update and Settings. Remote Play with {apps} may need the newest one.

sony.name: PlayStation Portal
sony.what: the PlayStation Portal remote player's system software
sony.how: Sony publishes no update list for it. The Portal updates itself when it is online: Settings, System Software, System Software Update. Its latest version is listed at playstation.com.
